fusions.name: Ledge Ram
fusions.desc: A ramming blow that deals 14 damage, leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds, makes it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Dislodged Boulder
fusions.desc: Heaves a chunk of reef at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to twice that at full reach, and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Hold the Line
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 8 seconds. A ring of polyps fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Shrugged Off
fusions.desc: Each time anything but fire hurts you, a shield worth 12% of your maximum health covers you for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds. You have 10% rock resistance.
